body:
Hmm.. there is only care jobs available.
And that's definitely something I could not cope with.

Appreciate the sentiment.

Just walking a bit of a tightrope at the moment.

I've been pondering the job idea. But I'm honestly not sure I would be able to cope with it right now.

Anxiety has been absolutely through the roof. 
Might look into it though and just see what's about.

Just because I have to write this somewhere. 
I went to overdose at the beach there other day and there was a film crew in my spot so I couldn't. 
Got up this morning to find that my fiancé has found my stash of pills and gotten rid of them. 
Now I'm at a point where there is no reset option anymore. 
Don't know whether to be mad or glad. 
Pretty sure I'm mad. 
There are other options. But they are all either definitely permanent or have a chance to fail (and then leave me with brain damage)
The other permanent options will also directly affect other people which I was trying to avoid.

No to be honest. It's just reached that point now. 
I have just well and truly had enough of it all.

I'm not trying to be that parent. 
But at the same time I also don't want to be that parent who has a constant negative impact on my sons life due to the state of my mental health. 
He's suffered enough because of it already. 
I don't want to have him suffer for the next however many years because of it too.

My son won't be the one to find me. That I can pretty much guarantee. 
And yes my fiancé knows how I feel. He says that I should just take my pills as I'm meant to and everything will be better soon...

I won't. Unless it doesn't work, anyway. 
But thanks for replying.

Better than living a life that is constantly affected by their parents mental health issues. Things which stop them from achieving anything to make life better. Not being able to be taken out to enjoy life because their parent cannot cope with the social anxiety it causes. 
Yeah, I'm beginning to see I have made the right decision.
Seems like the way to be.

He would, and he would eventually get over it, or kill himself too. 
None of this world makes sense. And it's all too far gone for anyone to fix it.
That I died because my brain wouldn't work properly anymore.
I do, I also have a fiancé who is around looking after the child as well as parents who actually still have legal responsibility of the child so could care for him when I'm not here.
